name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> (render / number_red_when_full). No address residue. Accurately reflects the wrapper's behavior confirmed by all 3 callers (fd2_render_full_char_stat_panel, fd2_render_mini_char_status_panel, fd2_render_terrain_info_hud_panel): render a decimal number drawn with the red 'full' glow when current == max, else white.
purpose: Thin wrapper around fd2_render_decimal_number_to_buffer that selects the digit color from whether current equals max (red 'full' glow 0x1F when current==max, else white 0x2A), then draws current as the value.
logic_summary: color = (current == max) ? 0x1F : 0x2A; then fd2_render_decimal_number_to_buffer(dst_off, pitch, current, color, digits). max is used only for the equality test; current is forwarded as the value to render. The binary's __CHK(0x18) stack-probe prologue is compiler-generated. In Ghidra's decompile the 5 params show as confused placeholders (param_1..param_3, dst_buf, stride) where dst_buf actually holds max (equality RHS) and stride actually holds digits (5th arg passed through to the callee); this is the known __CHK/EAX-tracking placeholder confusion, not a real type/semantics difference. Cyclomatic complexity 2 (single equality branch).
signature: void __cdecl fd2_render_number_red_when_full(uint32 dst_off, uint32 pitch, uint32 current, uint32 max, uint32 digits)

params.name: param_1
params.semantics: Destination buffer byte-offset where the number is drawn; forwarded unchanged as the dst arg of fd2_render_decimal_number_to_buffer. Callers pass e.g. overlay_buffer + 0x344B (HP current digits).
params.reason: Live Ghidra name is the generic placeholder param_1; src already uses the correct semantic name dst_off. Stage-2 rename to dst_off.

params.name: param_2
params.semantics: Destination surface stride/pitch in bytes (callers pass 0x140 or the panel stride); forwarded unchanged as the stride arg of fd2_render_decimal_number_to_buffer.
params.reason: Live Ghidra name is the generic placeholder param_2; src uses pitch. Stage-2 rename to pitch.

params.name: param_3
params.semantics: The current stat value (e.g. HP/MP current). Used both as the left operand of the current==max equality test AND as the value forwarded to fd2_render_decimal_number_to_buffer to be drawn.
params.reason: Live Ghidra name is the generic placeholder param_3; src uses current. Stage-2 rename to current.

params.name: dst_buf
params.semantics: The maximum stat value (e.g. HP/MP max). Used only as the right operand of the current==max equality test that selects the red full-glow color; never forwarded to the renderer.
params.reason: Live Ghidra name dst_buf is flatly wrong/misleading (it is the equality RHS 'max', not a destination buffer) and is a placeholder from the __CHK prologue confusion. src already declares it uint32 max. Stage-2 rename to max.

params.name: stride
params.semantics: Digit count forwarded unchanged as the 5th (digit_count) arg of fd2_render_decimal_number_to_buffer; callers pass 3 (HP/MP 3-digit fields).
params.reason: Live Ghidra name stride is flatly wrong/misleading (it is the digit_count passed through to the renderer, not a stride; the real pitch is param_2). Placeholder from the __CHK prologue confusion. src already declares it uint32 digits. Stage-2 rename to digits.

returns.semantics: No return value; delegates all rendering to fd2_render_decimal_number_to_buffer.
